note: Thorvald's arena takes your weapons, armour and runes; only jewellery goes in.
description: Thorvald's arena in the Fremennik Trials strips weapons, armour and runes, leaving jewellery as the only gear a player carries in; the optional dramen staff is made inside from a branch and a knife. Because no runes reach the fight, no spell can be cast and no thrall summoned, which is what the forbidden magic style and thrall flag record. God books and boots of lightness are also permitted but are not modelled, since neither carries an offensive stat; potions are not on the banned list and are left alone.

quotes: You cannot use any weapons, armour, fletching materials (such as logs/arrowtips), or bring runes.
The Ardougne cloak counts as armour, but the boots of lightness do not.
However, you can use food, Prayer, god books, and jewellery.
If you have low combat stats you may bring a god book, rings of recoil (7 minimum), goblin paint cannon, phoenix necklaces, a dramen branch and knife.

options.label: Dramen staff
options.description: <html>Made inside from a branch and a knife, neither of which is a weapon.</html>

note: The Dawnbringer is taken from the skeleton outside Verzik's room.
description: The Dawnbringer is taken from a skeleton by the entrance to Verzik's throne room and used on her first phase. It is destroyed on any attempt to use it outside that room, so no bank can hold it and the encounter pool has to supply it.

quotes: a built in failsafe where it's destroyed when you attempt to do anything with it outside of Verzik's room

note: The Gauntlet stores everything you walk in with; this is what the arena makes.
description: The Gauntlet stores everything a player walks in with, so the gear pool is only what the arena itself makes: the crystalline helm, body and legs, and the crystalline halberd, bow and staff, each in basic, attuned and perfected form, plus the starting sceptre. No crystal dagger is listed among them, and weapon and armour tier are separate ladders because the arena's shards are spent on one or the other. Every creature in the arena is under the same rule, not the Hunllef alone, and since no items or pre-applied boosts cross the entrance, no combat potion and no thrall reach the fight; the egniol potion made inside restores run energy and prayer and boosts no combat stat.

quotes: Players cannot bring any items into the Gauntlet; when entering the minigame, all items currently on the player will be automatically stored for its duration.
You cannot bring any items into or out of this activity
any pre-applied skill boosts will also be removed upon entry
